# TypingMaster

> TypingMaster is a comprehensive typing tutor software platform offering desktop applications, online tools, and interactive games to help users improve their typing speed and accuracy through touch typing training.

TypingMaster provides both downloadable Windows software (TypingMagic 12 and Ultimate Typing Coach) and web-based typing tools, games, and speed tests. The platform serves individual learners and educational institutions with 25+ years of industry experience, supporting multiple languages including English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish, Swedish, and Finnish.

## Online Tools & Speed Tests

- [Typing Master Online Tools, Tests & Games](https://www.typingmaster.com/online): Online typing tools, games, speed tests, and practice resources with Touch Typing Simulator.
- [Live Typing Rate Meter (Real-Time WPM) - TypingMaster](https://www.typingmaster.com/typing-meter): Real-time typing speed meter tracking WPM and keystroke performance with heatmap.
- [Typing Simulator: Touch Typing vs Hunt-and-Peck Speed](https://www.typingmaster.com/typing-simulator): Interactive typing simulator comparing touch typing and two-finger typing WPM.
- [Reading Speed Test - Words Per Minute Test Online](https://www.typingmaster.com/reading-speed-test): Free online reading speed test measuring WPM and reading comprehension skills.
- [Speech Speed Test - Check Your Speaking Speed in WPM | TypingMaster](https://www.typingmaster.com/speech-speed-test): Free online speech speed test measuring speaking WPM using microphone and Web Speech API.
